functions.role: Caller: byte input/BOM handling, parser guard, Config2 selection
Root Grammar: EOF/EOL/Sep/Object; true at EOF, throw mismatch
Quoted token; accepts empty; throws on unmatched Character
Escaped: quote and backslash only; rewind on failure
Character: Escaped then Regular excluding CR/LF; unknown backslash retained
ASCII space mask, bytes9..13 and32
Double-slash comment, LF/CRLF or EOF
Sep alternatives; failed block attempt marker rewinds
One-or-more Seps, repeat-tail marker and initial-failure distinction
Direct block comment attempt; false can consume slash or unfinished comment
Block comment opener component slash-star
Until first star-slash; nonnested block comment
KeyValue before Object ordered alternative; input rewind leaves action state
ObjectName action before opening brace; invokes ObjectMembers
Until closing brace, list(KeyValue/Object,Seps) or Seps; adjacent members accepted
ObjectName action pushes fresh node frame
Completed scalar assignment to current frame
Completed object frame pop and assignment to parent/root
Move node assignment clears/replaces destination child container; duplicates not merged
ObjectMembers throw helper
Grammar throw helper
Quoted Character throw helper
Substring used for first3-byte BOM comparison
Erase used for first3-byte BOM removal
Unimplemented file-reader boundary: empty init, stream-state guard, seek/tell/read, stream exceptions

grammar.quoted: Double quotes; only quote/backslash escapes decode
grammar.regular: Any byte excluding CR/LF, caller handles closing quote
grammar.duplicates: last completed node replaces entire prior node/subtree
grammar.root: zero or more EOL/Sep/Object until EOF, mismatch throws
grammar.rewind: input markers rewind, action state not rolled back

parse_result.reconstruction_exception: Own ParseError carrying rule category and post-BOM byte/line/column, not MSVC ABI/message exact
parse_result.plain_false: not found in inspected normal control flow; caller019ad0 retains guard

boundary.configuration_bridge: Requires mandatory external BinaryIterationOrder for original Windows config-copy stage
boundary.logical_order: First-created key slots and completed assignment chronology; not MSVC hash-list order
